verdict.rationale: Kong's plugin hub explicitly covers logging and monitoring plugins, and its AI/MCP layers advertise observability and analytics, indicating traffic monitoring capability. However, the pack lacks explicit documentation of specific metrics/tracing integrations (e.g., Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Zipkin) or dashboards, so the story is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: named metrics exporters (Prometheus), distributed tracing plugin details (OpenTelemetry/Zipkin), and independent confirmation of monitoring setup working in production.
